transcript: Mundane Wednesday, nothing much to report, Atlas still going but at least no new disasters today. April starting quiet, which after March I'll take gladly.

Pottery Thursday, glazed pieces from last month came out of the kiln, that blue turned out even better than I hoped, deep and a little uneven in a way that feels intentional even though it wasn't. Small good moment to close the week on.

Nervous about getting coffee with Dario this weekend, our first time actually seeing each other in person since everything. Texting's been easy enough these past couple weeks but sitting across from him is a different thing entirely. Trying not to overthink it too much, easier said than done.

Run this morning, knee behaving well now, pushed the distance up a little more without any issues. Good to have this back fully, felt like myself again out there in a way I hadn't quite for a few weeks. Tomorrow's the Dario coffee, trying to just enjoy today first.

Had coffee with Dario today. Awkward, honestly, more awkward than the phone calls have been, something about sitting across a table from someone makes the two years of silence more physically present than a voice on the phone ever did. Long silences a few times where neither of us knew what to say next, both of us maybe a little afraid of saying the wrong thing and undoing whatever fragile progress we've made. But we stayed. Two hours, way longer than either of us probably planned for a first coffee. Talked around the actual fight still, didn't touch it directly, but we talked about Dad a little, carefully, edges only. I think we both know we'll have to get to the center of it eventually if this is going to actually mean something and not just be surface pleasantries forever. But not today. Today was just showing up and staying, and that felt like enough.

Monday, real spring light this morning, no overcast at all, actual warmth in the air on the walk to the office. Still thinking about yesterday's coffee with Dario, the good and the awkward parts both. Work steady today, nothing dramatic.

Decided today, actually decided, that I need to sit down with Priya and tell her the truth about how burnt out I've been this whole stretch, not the polite version I've been giving in check-ins, the actual version. Booked time on her calendar for next week. Nervous about it but also relieved just having made the decision instead of continuing to just quietly grind through it.

Noticed tonight that I've actually been sleeping well for weeks now, genuinely well, no four a.m. wake-ups in a long stretch. The curtains, sure, but also just things settling generally, Dario back in the picture, knee healed, Atlas theoretically nearing its end. Small quiet gratitude for that tonight.

Pottery Thursday, working on a set of matching mugs now, first time trying to make multiples that are actually supposed to look similar to each other, harder than it sounds. Good challenge though. Nervous energy about tomorrow's meeting with Priya sitting underneath the whole evening.

Evening with Sam tonight, good overall, dinner and a walk after, but there was this small off note somewhere in the middle of it I can't quite name, a beat of quiet that felt different from our usual comfortable quiet. Probably nothing, everyone has an off evening sometimes. Not going to read too much into it.
Saturday errands, groceries and a few things for the apartment. Quiet productive day, nothing eventful. Meeting with Priya on Tuesday looming a little in the back of my mind all day.

Ran this morning and found myself basically rehearsing what I'm going to say to Priya on Tuesday the whole way, muttering little fragments of it out loud between breaths probably looking like a crazy person to anyone I passed on the trail. Good use of the run though, felt more prepared by the end than when I started.

Monday, spring light lingering later now which is nice. Meeting with Priya is officially tomorrow, confirmed on the calendar, no backing out now. Rehearsed the key points again tonight, trying to keep it honest but not just a complaint session, want to actually propose something not just vent.

Told Priya everything today. All of it, the burnout admission from January, how Atlas has just kept grinding since December with barely a break, the resignation letter I drafted and never sent in March. Scared to say it all out loud honestly, worried it would sound like weakness or like I was threatening to quit as leverage, but she just listened, really listened, the way she has since the beginning. And then she said something I wasn't expecting, that she'd noticed, that she'd actually been trying to figure out how to raise it with me herself, and that there was an opening on a different team, Meridian, doing work that's genuinely more aligned with what I'm good at and less of the constant fire-fighting Atlas has been. I start there next month. Walking out of that conversation I felt something physically let go, my shoulders down from somewhere near my ears, an actual full breath instead of the shallow ones I've apparently been taking for months. My jaw wasn't even clenched, I didn't realize how long it had been clenched until it wasn't. Relief. Real relief.

Day-after lightness still holding, woke up this morning without that familiar dread in my stomach for the first time in months. Told Sam and Maya both the news, both genuinely happy for me. Starting to actually let myself believe things might be turning a corner.

Pottery Thursday, lighter energy in me tonight than I've brought to this class in a while, could feel it in how loose my hands were on the wheel. Made something a little experimental, not sure what it'll end up being, just followed the clay for once instead of forcing a plan onto it.

Friday, tired but the good kind of tired, tired-good instead of tired-drained, if that makes sense. Handing off Atlas pieces this week in preparation for the Meridian move, satisfying in its own way, watching a chapter actually close instead of just dragging on indefinitely.

Patio season officially started, sat outside with Maya and Tom at that place with the string lights for the first time this year, first warm enough evening for it. Good energy all around, everyone in a decent mood, spring doing what spring does to people after a long gray winter.

Quiet Sunday with Sam, tried to talk about something a little deeper, future plans, that kind of thing, and it just didn't quite land the way I wanted it to, conversation kept sliding sideways into smaller topics instead. Not a fight or anything, just a miss. Probably nothing. Probably.

Overcast Monday, one of the last of these this spring probably as the weather keeps trending warmer. Flat feeling again despite everything going better lately, Meridian starting soon, Dario steadier, but today just gray regardless. Doesn't erase the good, just sits alongside it.

Got a letter from the landlord today, building's being sold, new owners want current tenants out within a couple months. Not what I needed on top of everything else honestly, even the good changes lately have been a lot, and now apartment hunting gets added to the pile. Trying not to spiral about it tonight, just letting it sit as a fact for now, will figure out logistics this week.

Mundane workday, Meridian handoff prep continuing, documenting everything for whoever picks up my Atlas pieces after I move teams. Apartment stuff still sitting unresolved in the back of my mind, haven't started actually looking yet.

Pottery Thursday, distraction from the apartment stress and everything else this week. Finished the experimental piece from last week, turned into a small vase, pretty happy with how it came out honestly, one of my favorites so far.

Sam said tonight we should have a real talk this weekend, said it in that particular tone that makes your stomach drop a little even before you know what it's about. Didn't push for details, just said okay. Sitting with a low-grade dread about it now, trying not to assume the worst but also not able to fully talk myself out of it either.

Quiet Saturday, basically just holding my breath waiting for tomorrow's conversation with Sam. Tried to distract myself with chores and a walk but nothing really worked, that particular kind of dread that sits right under everything else you're doing all day.

Sam and I broke up today. Nobody did anything wrong exactly, there's no villain in this version of the story, which almost makes it harder somehow, easier to be angry at someone than to just sit with the plain sad fact that something good has run its course. They said it's been feeling like we want slightly different things lately, not dramatically different, just enough of a gap that's been quietly widening since around that off evening a couple weeks ago, the one I noticed and then talked myself out of noticing. I think they're right, honestly, as much as it hurts to admit. We talked for a long time, calm mostly, a little crying on both sides near the end. No slammed doors, no cruelty, just two people being honest about something ending. I keep waiting to feel angrier than I do. Mostly I just feel the specific grief of losing something that was genuinely good, not because it broke but because it was never quite going to be the whole thing either of us needed. That's its own kind of sad, maybe a harder kind in some ways.

Day after, lonely in that specific quiet way, apartment feeling emptier than it should for just one less person's occasional presence in it. Went to work anyway, functional if not fully present, similar in a way to those first days after Nonna, going through motions while something processes underneath. Told Maya briefly, she came over tonight with food, didn't push me to talk more than I wanted to.

Landlord confirmed the timeline, officially need to be out by end of June. Money stress creeping in on top of everything else this week, first and last month's rent somewhere new, moving costs, all of it landing at the worst possible time emotionally. Trying to just take it one task at a time instead of looking at the whole pile.

Dario texted something kind today, just checking in, said he'd heard from Mom about the breakup and was thinking of me. Small warmth in an otherwise hard week. Nice to have that thread still open and actually being used for something good.

Pottery Thursday to close out the month, quieter class for me tonight, less chatting with the others than usual, just needed the hands-busy quiet more than the socializing. Finished a bowl I'd been working on for two weeks. Month's ending on a strange mixed note, Meridian starting soon which is good, the breakup which isn't, the apartment hunt looming. Sitting in my empty-feeling apartment with a bowl I made myself, some kind of small comfort in that at least.
